{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Drop QA orders
completed_orders_clean = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Compute final mean revenue
mean_revenue_final = completed_orders_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Explicitly print the count of completed orders after removing QA orders
print(f'Number of completed orders: {len(completed_orders)}')
print(f'Number of QA orders among completed: {len(qa_orders)}')
print(f'Number of real completed orders (after removing QA): {len(completed_orders_clean)}')
print(f'Mean revenue of real completed orders: {mean_revenue_final:.2f}')"}
